title: Cosmic Ritual Gathering
description: A surreal black-background scene featuring a large horned central creature surrounded by smaller white-line human figures in ritualistic poses. The lower half is covered in a dense field of overlapping multicolored circles while the upper portion contains floating rings, star-like shapes, and smoke-like wisps.
prompt: Surreal black background scene with a large horned central creature drawn in white lines, surrounded by smaller human figures in ritual poses. Dense field of overlapping colorful circles in purple, green, yellow, red, and blue covers the bottom half. Floating golden rings, stars, and smoke-like forms in the upper dark space. Mystical ritual atmosphere with high contrast between the white linework and dark void.
